name: Free tools
when: default. A list of free tools that solve a practical, everyday problem. The reader arrives with a problem and leaves with a solution.

name: Discoveries
when: the hook is curiosity, not a problem: 'this exists?!'. The reader arrives curious.

name: Privacy and security
when: privacy, protecting accounts, passwords, leaks, scams, tracking.

name: Artificial intelligence
when: only when all or almost all the tools are AI tools.
